a.xlink:title: Invoice — shipment event. Financial event triggers GL and inventory movement. Model: apps/transactions/models/invoice.py Functions: transfer_order_to_invoice @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:16 (creates invoice from order) Pending.objects.create @ apps/transactions/services/order_to_invoice.py:332 (-on_hand, -on_so, +on_in) Pending deltas: on_hand: -qty, on_so: -qty, on_in: +qty GL: AR debit, Revenue credit, Tax credit, COGS debit, Inventory credit, Commission

Payment — handles AR (received) and AP (expense). Signed amounts. Category maps to GL. Statement Sorter feeds expense side. Model: apps/transactions/models/payment.py Functions: Payment @ apps/transactions/models/payment.py:1 (AR+AP via type field; signed amounts)
